description: Sample golden set for Hiver Support Agent evaluation
sampling_method: Stratified random sampling across intent categories and conversation types
labeling_instructions: Each example was manually labelled with intent, escalation decision, and expected response approach

examples.customer_message: My package was supposed to arrive yesterday but it's still not here. Where is it?
examples.expected_response_approach: Provide tracking information and estimated delivery date

examples.customer_message: I've been charged twice for the same order. This is unacceptable! I want my money back now!
examples.expected_response_approach: Acknowledge the duplicate charge, apologize, and initiate refund process

examples.customer_message: Your product is defective and caused damage to my property. I'm going to sue you if this isn't resolved immediately.
examples.expected_response_approach: Requires legal team involvement due to threat of lawsuit

examples.customer_message: Can you tell me if this product is compatible with Mac computers?
examples.expected_response_approach: Provide compatibility information based on product specifications

examples.customer_message: I can't log into my account. It keeps saying invalid password but I'm using the right one.
examples.expected_response_approach: Guide through password reset process and account recovery

examples.customer_message: The app keeps crashing every time I try to open it. I've tried reinstalling but nothing works.
examples.expected_response_approach: Provide advanced troubleshooting steps and request device information

examples.customer_message: I need to speak to your manager right now. This is ridiculous!
examples.expected_response_approach: Customer explicitly requested management - requires human intervention

examples.customer_message: What are your customer service hours?
examples.expected_response_approach: Provide customer service hours and contact information

examples.customer_message: I ordered this item 2 weeks ago and still haven't received it. The tracking hasn't updated in 10 days.
examples.expected_response_approach: Investigate tracking status and provide updated delivery estimate

examples.customer_message: Why did my subscription price go up without any notice? This is bait and switch!
examples.expected_response_approach: Customer upset about pricing changes - may require account review
